isolation.strategy: Each arm uses its own equal-length cohort marker at the beginning of the stable prefix, before the original prompt content.

warm.interpretation: Both isolated prefix families independently demonstrated a cold miss followed by a warm hit. This validates the baseline but does not establish retention beyond 24 hours.

verify.interpretation: After 26.012 idle hours, neither isolated prefix family produced a cache hit. This completed run did not observe incremental retention from the linked Context Cache arm in this environment.

claimBoundary: This is one completed paired-prefix observation in one Private Preview environment. It did not observe incremental retention after 26.012 idle hours, but it does not establish product-wide behavior or the service's internal storage mechanism.
